entities.summary: Portuguese, a notable figure in the history of Bahrain, associated with Portuguese and Safavid Bahrain (1521–1602). Preceded by Portuguese conquer Bahrain and build fortifications at Qal'at al-Bahrain. Their legacy influenced Safavid-backed forces expel the Portuguese from Bahrain and Safavid Persian Rule.
